app.name: Super Mario 64 (720p benchmark)
app.long_description: Super Mario 64 for Wii, rendered natively at 1280x720 and output as 720p60 by reprogramming the VI pixel clock to 148.5 MHz. Needs a digital video output that accepts it (e.g. a RetroGEM); analog and GCVideo outputs will not show it. Uncapped timedemo benchmark with a CPU/GPU frame-time overlay. Options in apps/sm64/sm64config.txt: video_mode, bench_demo, bench_uncapped, bench_overlay. See https://github.com/Shank-Mods/sm64-port-wii-video-experiments/tree/wii-720p
